name: Listwise Rank Tool
description: Multi-judge consensus ranking: cross-family LLM judges independently rank candidates (each on its own anonymized labels, optionally several passes per judge for position-stability), rank-averaged into a consensus with Spearman consistency report

description_i18n.zh-CN: 多 Judge 共识排序：跨家族大模型对匿名候选独立全排序（每个 judge 一套独立编号映射），名次平均得到共识并给出 Spearman 一致性报告，消除单一模型偏好
description_i18n.en-US: Multi-judge consensus ranking with per-judge anonymization, rank averaging and Spearman consistency report

author: leo

tools.name: rank_candidates_listwise
tools.description: Rank candidates via multi-judge consensus (cross-family LLMs, per-judge anonymized listwise ranking, rank averaging, Spearman report)

config_fields.name: judges_json
config_fields.label: Judges Config (JSON array)
config_fields.help: Each judge: name/model required; endpoint = base_url or base_url_env (falls back to OPENAI_BASE_URL); missing /v1 suffix is auto-appended; api_key_env default OPENAI_API_KEY; optional temperature/extra_body (use extra_body for a gateway's response_format / guided_json to constrain output). Entries resolving to the same endpoint+model are merged into one vote. Empty = use JUDGE_MODELS env or built-in cross-endpoint defaults (dead endpoints are skipped with a warning)

config_fields.name: passes
config_fields.label: Per-judge Passes (position-stability ensembling)
config_fields.help: 1 = one ranking per judge (cheapest). 2-3 = the same judge ranks the slate under that many independent anonymizations; its ballots are averaged into one vote and the report gains a per-judge position-stability rho (below 0.9 names the judge as possibly order-driven). Cost is judges x passes calls, run in series per judge. No settings form? Set LISTWISE_RANK_PASSES in envs.json instead (restart needed). Default 1

meta.api_key_hint: 支持任意 OpenAI 兼容提供商：密钥从环境变量读取（api_key_env 指定变量名，默认 OPENAI_API_KEY），写入 ~/.qwenpaw.secret/envs.json（改动需重启生效）。未检测到任何提供商密钥时，首次调用将返回初始化向导（含常见厂商对照表与 judges_json 模板）。详见 README「Initialization」
